Title: 
Image Processing Engineer 
 
 
 BELONG. CONNECT. GROW. with KBR.
 Around here, we define the future. We are a company of innovators, thinkers, creators, explorers, volunteers, and dreamers. But we all share one goal: to improve the world responsibly and safely.
 
 Join us at the Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center and help shape the future of Earth science data systems. As part of our mission-driven team, you'll contribute to projects that make a global impact, supporting research, innovation, and technology that empower scientists and decision-makers worldwide.
 
 
 Position Overview
 KBR is seeking an Image Processing Engineer in Sioux Falls, SD, to support the USGS Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center. This is a full-time, onsite position requiring consistent, in-person collaboration with team members, scientists, and mission partners.
 In partnership with NASA and the Landsat project, this position supports Landsat product generation, which processes satellite imagery used by scientists, researchers, government agencies, and organizations around the world. You will develop and optimize high-performance image processing applications that support operational satellite data processing and future Earth observation initiatives.
 
 
 Why You'll Love This Role
 Contribute to meaningful, mission-critical Earth science initiatives
 Develop software supporting one of the world's longest-running satellite programs
 Work alongside experienced engineers and scientists who value innovation
 Apply advanced software engineering techniques to large-scale image processing systems
 Solve complex performance and scalability challenges
 Work with modern cloud technologies and scientific data-processing platforms
 
 
 Core Responsibilities
 As a Image Processing Engineer, you will independently execute engineering tasks and contribute throughout the software development lifecycle.
 Design, develop, and maintain image-processing software components
 Develop software primarily in C, with supporting development in Python
 Optimize algorithms and processing workflows to reduce runtime and improve processing throughput
 Design and maintain applications that write to and query relational databases
 Develop solutions that ingest, process, and distribute large volumes of satellite imagery and derived products
 Support cloud-based image-processing architectures and workflows
 Perform software planning, requirements refinement, and technical design activities
 Develop, execute, and document unit and integration tests
 Troubleshoot operational processing issues and implement corrective actions
 Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and technical discussions
 Collaborate closely with Systems Engineers, Software Engineers, Scientists, and mission stakeholders
 
 
 Education & Skills
 
 Education
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical discipline.
 
 Experience
 Seven or more years of professional software engineering experience
 Experience developing software in C within Linux/Unix environments
 Experience working with data-intensive processing systems
 Experience supporting cloud computing environments
 Experience interfacing with relational database systems
 Required Skills
 Strong proficiency in C programming
 Working knowledge of Python
 Experience writing software that interfaces with databases
 Relational database experience
 Linux/Unix expertise
 Experience improving software performance and decreasing processing runtime
 Strong understanding of software development lifecycle practices
 Experience with Git-based source control management
 Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills
 Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a highly skilled technical team
 Desired Skills
 Digital image processing experience
 Remote sensing or Earth observation experience
 Scientific computing experience
 Cloud-native processing architectures
 AWS cloud services experience
 Postgres database experience
 Satellite ground-system experience
 Mathematics, physics, or related scientific background
 Experience with AI-assisted software development and documentation tools
 
 
 Special Requirements
 Three years of continuous residency in the United States for issuance of a Government Security credential
 Ability to obtain and maintain a national agency check and background investigation for facility access
 
 Experience and/or Education in lieu of these qualifications will be reviewed for applicability to meet these requirements. 
 
 KBR Benefits:​  
 KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule.  We support career advancement through professional training and development.​ 
 Click here to learn more:   KBR Benefits | KBR

 Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture.  These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company.  That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.
